description: This file defines classes and methods for creating DWARF test data, specifically for constructing compilation units and abbreviation tables used in unit tests within the dwarf2reader component.

classes.name: TestCompilationUnit
classes.description: A subclass of test_assembler::Section for constructing DWARF compilation units, allowing setting format size, headers, and section offsets.

classes.name: TestAbbrevTable
classes.description: A subclass of test_assembler::Section for constructing DWARF abbreviation tables, supporting adding abbreviations and attributes.

methods.name: set_format_size
methods.description: Sets the DWARF format size (4 or 8 bytes) for the compilation unit.

methods.name: SectionOffset
methods.description: Appends a section offset value of appropriate size based on the format.

methods.name: Header
methods.description: Creates a DWARF compilation unit header with specified version, abbrev offset, and address size.

methods.name: Finish
methods.description: Marks the end of the current header's DIEs, updating the length.

methods.name: Abbrev
methods.description: Starts a new abbreviation table entry with code, tag, and child indicator.

methods.name: Attribute
methods.description: Adds an attribute to the current abbreviation with specified name and form.
